title: fuzzlab lab-generator safety matrix (CR-LAB-0001 §3/§6, D20 binary verdict)
description: An open, versioned registry of (op, sink_family) -> effect entries. Adding a transform op, a sink family, or a vulnerability class is appending an entry and bumping `version` — never editing an existing entry in place (append-only, like this project's change-control logs). `effect: partial` is the D20 binary-verdict mechanism: a partially-neutralized case stays VULNERABLE (never a third verdict value) and instead feeds a difficulty tier.

effect.description: neutralises: fully satisfies the listed concerns for this sink_family. partial: reduces but does not fully satisfy them (feeds the VULNERABLE difficulty tier, never a third verdict value — D20). no_effect: this op does nothing for this sink_family (e.g. an HTML-escaping op against a SQL sink). introduces: this op adds new required-neutralization concerns not previously required (e.g. a debug/error-leak op reintroducing exposure after an otherwise-safe pipeline).

neutralizes.description: Concern IDs this op addresses for this sink_family. Required (non-empty) when effect is neutralises or partial; ignored otherwise.

introduces.description: Concern IDs newly required because of this op. Required (non-empty) when effect is introduces; ignored otherwise.
